info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Status Transition Management API
info.description: The Loan Status Transition Management API enables the modification of loan statuses within the lending system. By utilizing this endpoint, users can update a loan's status, ensuring that the system accurately reflects the current state of each loan. This API is primarily utilized by loan administrators and financial institutions to manage loan workflows effectively, address customer inquiries, and maintain operational compliance. It plays a crucial role in streamlining the loan management process and enhancing overall customer service.

put.summary: Update the status transitions of a specific loan.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the status transitions for a loan identified by its ID. It enables effective tracking and managing of loan statuses as they progress through different phases.

requestBody.description: Updates the status of the loan with the specified transitions. This request body must adhere to the defined structure to ensure proper processing of the status change.

200.description: Request processed successfully; the status of the loan has been updated.
